scientific_integrity: The local center condition is credited to da Cruz and Torregrosa; classic separatrix asymptotics not claimed new. Every coefficient and region is supported by the standalone proof; numeric checks are supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Only the explicitly displayed C1 two-zone quadratic subfamily with nonnegative coefficients on y<1; no global plane, general perturbation, or all-period monotonicity theorem. Possible unindexed prior equivalents. Independent validation unperformed.
title: Three sharp period-edge regimes in a continuous two-zone quadratic center
